items.title: Promote the reviewed execution plan into the canonical decisions corpus
items.context: Preserve the evidence-calibrated /tmp document as docs/requirements/decisions/role-prompt-modularization-and-budget-execution-plan.md without changing runtime behavior.
items.userSees: The reviewed plan is durable in the repository decision source of truth.

happy.desc: Canonical decision file exists at docs/requirements/decisions/role-prompt-modularization-and-budget-execution-plan.md and is byte-for-byte identical to the reviewed /tmp source: SHA-256 3a7e9beaf60b692753de91ee50eeacccdadfd57586fb28b6d07189d953b60610, 50,347 bytes, and 1,256 lines; while the source remains available, cmp -s must also pass.

The promoted document remains a complete readable Markdown execution plan with the original H1, all numbered sections, seven ordered Story milestones, and the separate conditional budget-enforcement follow-up; its 18 fenced-code delimiters remain balanced.

edge.desc: Verification does not depend solely on the temporary file continuing to exist: if /tmp is later unavailable, the committed destination must still match the recorded SHA-256, byte count, and line count rather than being reconstructed or silently truncated.

The Unicode Chinese/English content, code blocks, tables, inline identifiers, paths, and relative references survive promotion without encoding corruption, newline-induced content drift, or broken Markdown fence structure.

adversarial.desc: Promotion introduces no optimization, paraphrase, omitted caveat, changed role status, altered budget threshold, or reordered milestone: any content delta from the reviewed source fails this item even if the resulting document appears editorially improved.

This documentation-only item changes no runtime source, prompt asset, registry, configuration, handler, gate, generated artifact, package version, or test behavior; repository diff attributable to CHK-001 is limited to creation of the canonical decision document, with navigation handled separately by CHK-002.

items.title: Expose the promoted plan through requirements navigation
items.context: Add a concise navigation entry so later Stories and reviewers can find the canonical plan without relying on the temporary file.
items.userSees: The canonical requirements navigation links to the promoted plan.

happy.desc: docs/requirements/NAV.md contains a descriptive Markdown entry whose relative target is exactly decisions/role-prompt-modularization-and-budget-execution-plan.md; resolving that link from NAV.md reaches the promoted canonical document, so a reader can discover and open the plan without using /tmp.

edge.desc: After promotion, navigation metadata remains internally accurate: the direct decisions-document inventory count is updated if the new file changes it, and the plan has exactly one canonical navigation entry with no duplicate entry or alternate repository path.

The navigation entry preserves the curated decisions list structure and uses the actual promoted document title and path with exact case, punctuation, and .md suffix so it resolves on case-sensitive filesystems.

adversarial.desc: Repository search proves docs/requirements/NAV.md does not link to /tmp, /private/tmp, the attachment path, an absolute local filesystem path, or any compatibility/staging copy; deleting the temporary source would not break discovery of the canonical plan.

A link-resolution check from docs/requirements/NAV.md must fail for typoed, missing, directory-traversing, or non-canonical targets; acceptance requires the checked-in target under docs/requirements/decisions and must not be satisfied by matching link text alone.

The navigation wording must not claim that the execution plan has already changed runtime behavior, completed its numbered implementation Stories, or enabled budget enforcement; it exposes a plan-only decision record whose later Stories remain responsible for implementation.
